title: Gotrade Daily: Democrats Lead, AMD and Qualcomm Tonight
summary: Democrats are projected to control both chambers and futures fell. Tonight: the reaction to AMD, CVS before the open and Qualcomm after the close.
body_markdown:
JPMorgan expects a large Democratic win could push the S&P 500 down about 0.5% on Wednesday. Goldman Sachs said a Democratic Congress might limit data center tax incentives, though it sees a national moratorium as unlikely,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/midterm-election-stock-market.html) .


### AMD and AI chip stocks


**Advanced Micro Devices ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** reported Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion, up 45%, with Data Center segment revenue of $8.5 billion, up 97%. Non-GAAP earnings per share were $2.09, up 74%,[according to AMD's release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000002488/000000248826000188/q32026991.htm) .


Revenue and earnings per share were above LSEG estimates of $13.09 billion and $1.95. AMD expects fourth-quarter revenue of about $17 billion, above the $16.2 billion estimate, with a gross margin of about 55%. CEO Lisa Su expects server revenue to double in 2027,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/amd-amd-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html) .


**Arista Networks ([ANET](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/anet/) )** expects fourth-quarter revenue of $3.9 billion to $4.0 billion,[according to Arista's release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001596532/000159653226000252/ex991q326-earningsrelease.htm) , above the $3.60 billion estimate, according to CNBC.


### CVS this morning, Qualcomm after the close


**CVS Health ([CVS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cvs/) )** holds its Q3 call at 8 a.m. ET,[according to CVS Health](https://www.cvshealth.com/news/company-news/cvs-health-to-hold-third-quarter-2026-earnings-conference-call.html) . The Financial Times reported that CVS plans to separate its roughly 9,000 pharmacies into a standalone public company, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/cvs-health-to-split-into-two-publicly-traded-companies-by-2028-ft-reports-4997046) . CVS has not confirmed the plan.


**Qualcomm ([QCOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/qcom/) )** reports fiscal Q4 2026 results after the close, with its call at 1:45 p.m. PT,[according to Qualcomm](https://www.qualcomm.com/news/releases/2026/10/qualcomm-schedules-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2026-earnings-relea) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of 11:24 p.m. ET on Tuesday, S&P 500 futures were down 1.25% at 7,501.50, Nasdaq 100 futures were down 2.26% at 27,666 and Dow futures were down 0.77% at 51,498, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-steady-with-midterms-in-focus-amd-rallies-on-strong-earnings-4997029) .


In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 4.45% to its lowest since May, while South Korea's Kospi rose 2.95%,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


## Macro Note 📝


The 10-year Treasury yield fell nearly 5 basis points to 4.902% and the 2-year yield fell 6 basis points to 4.55%,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . ISM releases its October services PMI at 10 a.m. ET,[according to FinanceCalendar](https://www.financecalendar.com/event/us-ism-services-pmi-november-2026/) .


## Conclusion


Tonight the market weighs projected Democratic control of Congress against AMD's better-than-expected results, while waiting for CVS's report and the services PMI.


The US market opens at 9:30 a.m. ET. Qualcomm's results arrive only after the 4 p.m. ET close, and several congressional races are still being counted.
